title: The BF calculus is an axiomatically complete extension of Laws of Form

statements.text: The BF algebra is a stronger, axiomatically complete extension of Laws of Form that can represent other four-valued systems, among them the Kauffman and Varela waveform algebra and Belnap's four-valued bilattice.

sources.quote: We show that the BF algebra is an stronger, axiomatically complete extension to Laws of Form capable of representing other four-valued systems
